/** id(..) as N: a merge point, and a loop head carrying a struct. */
export type E =
  | { readonly tag: "A"; readonly value: number }
  | { readonly tag: "B"; readonly value: number };

/** The type of the parameters of Merge. */
export interface MergeArgs {
  readonly e: E;
}

/** The type of the parameters of Sum. */
export interface SumArgs {
  readonly xs: readonly number[];
}

/** The type of the return of Sum.L. */
export interface SumLOut {
  readonly i: number;
  readonly acc: number;
}


==== client.ts
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A typed function per route of each HTTP server, sending its arguments and
// decoding its result as the servers' JSON. Framework-neutral: hooks.ts adds
// React on top.

import type * as $t from "./types";

// [react]'s api_base, which each route's path goes after.
export const $base = "";

/** Runs proc Merge: `POST /api/merge` on http server web-api. */
export async function merge(args: { readonly e: $t.E }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<number> {
  const v = await $call("POST", "/api/merge", {
    "e": $enc_E(args.e),
  }, opts);
  return $decInt(v, "result");
}

/** Runs proc Sum: `GET /api/sum` on http server web-api. */
export async function sum(args: { readonly xs: readonly number[] }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<number> {
  const v = await $call("GET", "/api/sum", {
    "xs": $encList($encInt)(args.xs),
  }, opts);
  return $decInt(v, "result");
}

export function $enc_E(x: $t.E): unknown {
  if (x.tag === "A") return { "A": $encInt(x.value) };
  if (x.tag === "B") return { "B": $encInt(x.value) };
  return $notA(x, "E");
}

export function $dec_E(v: unknown, at: string): $t.E {
  const [tag, p] = $variant(v, at);
  if (tag === "A" && p !== $bare) return { tag: "A", value: $decInt(p, at + ".A") };
  if (tag === "B" && p !== $bare) return { tag: "B", value: $decInt(p, at + ".B") };
  return $noVariant(v, at, "E");
}

export function $enc_MergeArgs(x: $t.MergeArgs): unknown {
  return {
    "e": $enc_E(x.e),
  };
}

export function $dec_MergeArgs(v: unknown, at: string): $t.MergeArgs {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    e: $dec_E($field(o, "e", at), at + ".e"),
  };
}

export function $enc_SumArgs(x: $t.SumArgs): unknown {
  return {
    "xs": $encList($encInt)(x.xs),
  };
}

export function $dec_SumArgs(v: unknown, at: string): $t.SumArgs {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    xs: $decList($decInt)($field(o, "xs", at), at + ".xs"),
  };
}

export function $enc_SumLOut(x: $t.SumLOut): unknown {
  return {
    "i": $encInt(x.i),
    "acc": $encInt(x.acc),
  };
}

export function $dec_SumLOut(v: unknown, at: string): $t.SumLOut {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    i: $decInt($field(o, "i", at), at + ".i"),
    acc: $decInt($field(o, "acc", at), at + ".acc"),
  };
}

==== hooks.ts
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A React hook per route of each HTTP server, over client.ts: each gives the
// route's last result or error and whether a call is in flight, and cancels
// calls that are no longer wanted.

import * as React from "react";
import * as $c from "./client";
import type * as $t from "./types";

/**
 * Runs proc Merge through merge (`POST /api/merge` on http server web-api):
 * with args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useMerge(args?: { readonly e: $t.E } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly e: $t.E }, number> {
  return $useCall($c.merge, args, opts);
}

/**
 * Runs proc Sum through sum (`GET /api/sum` on http server web-api): with
 * args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useSum(args?: { readonly xs: readonly number[] } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly xs: readonly number[] }, number> {
  return $useCall($c.sum, args, opts);
}
